_doc: Golden states of the Home proof of concept (launcher/render/home-poc). Fields: id, program, title, phase, web (the scripts/shots.mjs shot it must match), fixture (else the web shot's set), screen (RR_SCREEN), script (RR_SCRIPT), res (subset of resolutions), budget (gate tools/render/budget.py on its RR_STATS log), env (extra variables). See tools/render/golden/golden.py.
